name: Rebellious Children
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of honoring and obeying parents as a foundational command with blessings attached, as seen in Exodus 20:12. The seriousness of rebellion against parental authority is underscored in Leviticus 20:9 and Deuteronomy 21:18, where persistent disobedience is met with severe consequences. Proverbs highlights the necessity of loving discipline, teaching that timely correction and training in the right way are essential to guide children away from folly and toward lasting obedience and wisdom.
